g.title: Flow
g.text: Implemented checks, timing ownership and command lifetime · not verified on the physical robot

g.title: imu
g.text: micro-ROS epoch stamp at read time

g.title: snapshot
g.text: finite / complete q and dq; source + receipt ages ≤ 100 ms
IMU / JointState stamp skew ≤ 20 ms in real-feedback mode

g.title: supervisor
g.text: IMU fall / freshness / stuck checks → latched /safety/estop

g.title: joints
g.text: CAN RX → calibrated joint coordinates (direction, offset, ankle four-bar)
JointState stamp = oldest included receive time

g.title: policy
g.text: latest input only; no inference FIFO or catch-up bursts

g.title: post
g.text: snapshot still fresh; work ≤ 20 ms; finite output; no fault / estop
expired result discarded; policy fault latches

g.title: command
g.text: training angle bounds + model Kp / Kd
header.stamp = oldest input source time · valid_until = source + timeout

g.title: cpp
g.text: missing feedback / expired command / estop → disable all

g.title: can
g.text: bounded latest-command mailbox · per-joint monotonic deadline
fresh explicit ENABLE + asynchronous healthy status ACK required

g.title: map
g.text: finite command / nonnegative gains; joint bounds; velocity / torque clamp
direction, offset and ankle four-bar mapping

g.title: tx
g.text: recheck expiry before sending · zero-wait SocketCAN submit
audited RS02 / RS03 / RS04 MIT encoding · independent RX threads

g.title: motor
g.text: position error and Kp / Kd generate actuator effort

g.title: lifetime
g.text: C++ relay and CAN retransmission never renew source time or expiry.
Invalid / stale control state and expired commands keep their disable behavior.
Limits shown are configuration, not measured hardware guarantees.

g.title: planned
g.text: physical-robot validation of every path in this diagram

g.title: old->can
g.text: still subject to CAN backend gates
